description: This file provides a helper utility, DeviceInfoHelper, which offers static methods to retrieve device and platform information such as OS version, device family, model identifier, app version, and build details. It is intended for use in app settings, payloads, and device status reports.

methods.name: platformString
methods.description: Returns a string with OS name and version, e.g., 'iOS 18.0.0' or 'iPadOS 18.0.0'.

methods.name: platformStringForDisplay
methods.description: Returns a display string with platform and version, e.g., 'iOS 18.0.0'.

methods.name: deviceFamily
methods.description: Returns the device family, e.g., 'iPad', 'iPhone', or 'iOS'.

methods.name: modelIdentifier
methods.description: Retrieves the device's hardware model identifier, e.g., 'iPhone17,1'.

methods.name: appVersion
methods.description: Gets the app's marketing version string.

methods.name: appBuild
methods.description: Gets the app's build number string.

methods.name: openClawVersionString
methods.description: Returns a combined version string for display, e.g., '1.2.3 (456)'.
